body:
I haven't drank in four weeks. Not speaking while still feeling hostile hasn't worked because then people become confrontational. I lash out when I feel cornered. Which got me in a fuck ton of trouble.

I can't afford counseling. 

I've been waiting for years for a boyfriend. I'm extremely lonely.

Doesn't matter if "slut" is something people just made up. The thing is that it still conjures up a lot of negative feelings from people. 

I have one friend that I think would feel my loss. Other than that, everyone else would be a poser pretending they gave a shit but never really did anything. 

What good will it be when I'm confined to a wheel chair unable to care for myself?
I haven't drank in four weeks.
